quotes.verbatim_quote:
What follows is a brief, introductory study of how to arrive at different 3-part chords
by leaving out one voice of a 4-part chord.
quotes.why_load_bearing: This defines the core method of the chapter: deriving 3-part chords by omitting one voice from a 4-part chord.
This is the key taxonomic rule showing exactly which 3-part chord types emerge when one voice is dropped from a 7th chord.
This observation encodes a symmetry rule: every 3-part chord type can be found inside four different 4-part families, a concept with direct practical implications for reharmonization.
